# EveMarket Screener

> Free station-trading screener for EVE Online. Shows which items in the five main EVE trade hubs (Jita, Amarr, Dodixie, Rens and Hek) are worth trading, ranked by ROI, spread and liquidity, with prices and calculations refreshed every 5 minutes (daily volumes once a day).
> Available in English (default), Spanish, German, French and Italian, each at its own URL (`/es/`, `/de/`, `/fr/`, `/it/`).

The public Screener requires no account. The "My Orders" and "Settings" sections are private, for the site owner's personal use, and are not public content.

## What it does
- Classifies every item in each trade hub into four states:
  - Potential: spread, liquidity and real market activity over the last 7 days meet the criteria.
  - No orders: spread and liquidity qualify, but the executed-trade history is too low (little volume or few trades per day).
  - Under observation: borderline case, more history is needed.
  - Discarded: losing spread or unviable liquidity.
- Computes per item: best buy and sell price, spread, ROI, real daily volume and trades per day.
- Lets you pick the market to explore (`?market=jita|amarr|dodixie|rens|hek`; Jita is the default) and filter and sort by category, name, ROI, spread, price, volume and 7-day price trend.
- Each item has a detail view with its recent price and volume history.

## Pages
- [Screener](https://evemarket-analyzer.online/): main listing, public.
- [All items](https://evemarket-analyzer.online/items): one plain HTML page per item that is a station-trading candidate, each comparing the item across the five hubs (best buy and sell price, ROI, trades per day, status and 7-day price trend per hub) plus its Jita details.
- [Español](https://evemarket-analyzer.online/es/) · [Deutsch](https://evemarket-analyzer.online/de/) · [Français](https://evemarket-analyzer.online/fr/) · [Italiano](https://evemarket-analyzer.online/it/)

## Data and limits
- Source: the ESI, CCP Games' official API for EVE Online (not scraping).
- Markets covered: Jita (The Forge), Amarr (Domain), Dodixie (Sinq Laison), Rens (Heimatar) and Hek (Metropolis), each as a whole region. Each market has its own plain HTML page (`/jita/`, `/amarr/`, `/dodixie/`, `/rens/`, `/hek/`; localized under `/es/`, `/de/`, `/fr/`, `/it/`) with its top candidates. The per-item pages compare all five hubs; an item has a page when it is a candidate in Jita.
- Frequency: the prices-and-calculations cycle runs every 5 minutes; market history (daily volumes) updates once a day.
- Informational tool, not investment advice nor an in-game purchase recommendation.
- Independent site, not affiliated with CCP Games. EVE Online is a trademark of CCP hf.
